scientific_integrity: Exact closed-form transition and displacement means and an analytic finite-state Markov-reward proof. Standalone deterministic checker supplements, not replaces, the infinite-time proof. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Last-reset-site-dependent exponential clocks, Brownian diffusion, two alternating Voronoi-site gaps, strictly positive rates. No assertion for instantaneous-position-dependent reset rates, finite return times, fluctuation diffusivity, or uniqueness of an optimal reset scale. A published-record and accessible-history comparison is not a proof of worldwide publication priority.
title: A sharp two-sublattice rectification law for nearest-site stochastic resetting
